about: Renew the licence of a private nursery in Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the official ADEK Licensing System guide page on the checked date. Details are filled in after sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Staff details updated on the PASS system
fees: The application fee applies; the amount is not stated on the page
channels: ADEK Licensing System (licensing.adek.gov.ae), from the dashboard or the Services tab of the nursery
